title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to Blazor WASM
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision ...: Error: Timed out after 285622ms waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root '<guid>'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: All three failing tests in the Windows browser-debugger E2E job time out waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session (or the Blazor WASM root session) to attach, a well-established recurring flaky pattern with 14 prior occurrences tracked under issue #19618. The PR under test (#19675) only adds Azure provisioning proxy SDK generation code and has no relation to the VS Code extension's Blazor WASM browser debugger E2E harness, so the failure is not attributable to the PR's changes.
